fields.label: Tender Bid
fields.description: The bid this send belongs to - the ledger outlives the audit fields on the bid (dispatched_on/to hold only the LAST send; every send appends a record here)

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Which F-13 dispatch tier sent: 'pack' (full bid pack attached) or 'correspondence' (written message, never attaches the pack)

fields.label: Recipient
fields.description: The confirmed buyer contact address the send actually went to (post retype-to-confirm)

fields.label: Dispatched On
fields.description: When the send was accepted by the mail system - same instant the bid's dispatched_on audit field was written

fields.label: Dispatched By
fields.description: The session user who confirmed and triggered the send

fields.label: Pack Signed
fields.description: Whether the dispatched pack was the SIGNED regeneration (profile carried a signature image) - mirrors the endpoint's pack_signed result

fields.label: Pack SHA-256
fields.description: Hex sha256 of the dispatched pack HTML EXACTLY as attached to the send (plan #11: dispatch regenerates the pack at send time, so this digest - not any later regeneration - is what the buyer received). Empty for correspondence sends

fields.label: Manifest SHA-256
fields.description: Hex sha256 of the dispatched manifest JSON string as attached. Empty for correspondence sends

fields.label: Message SHA-256
fields.description: Hex sha256 of the email body as sent (both tiers); empty when no body was sent

fields.label: Attachment Count
fields.description: How many files were attached to the send (2 for pack mode: pack HTML + manifest JSON; 0 for correspondence)

fields.label: Attachments (JSON)
fields.description: Per-attachment entries [{fname, sha256, size_bytes, file_url}] in send order - file_url points at the private File on the bid holding the ACTUAL sent bytes (empty when the File store write failed; the digest still stands)
